text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, I come across Symboli Rudolf in the cafeteria, sitting in front of a veritable buffet of dishes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer. What an unexpected pleasure.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Quite the sight, isn't it? These are new dishes that the chef has… cooked up, if you'll excuse the pun.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: The academy staff are constantly searching for new ways to make campus life more enjoyable for the students.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That includes revising the cafeteria menu from time to time. It's hard to overstate the debt we owe them.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Seeing as we share a common goal, I thought the least I could do is lend a hand…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Which is why I have offered to serve as a taste-tester.
choice_data_list: Don't you think this is a bit much?
Don't you think this is a bit much?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Which is why I have offered to serve as a taste-tester.
choice_data_list: Don't you think this is a bit much?
Don't you think this is a bit much?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Indeed. I appreciate the chef's enthusiasm, but I can't possibly finish all this.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Still, now that I have offered my assistance, I have to make good on my word. What to do…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But of course. How silly of me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: If I wanted to find somebody who cares deeply for Umamusume, I didn't have to look far, did I?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: By all means, I would welcome your assistance.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: With our combined efforts, we can make this cafeteria the best it can be!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf and I spend the rest of the day sampling a variety of dishes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Quite. There are a formidable number of dishes to get through, and they all seem awfully filling…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But if this will help create a menu that can satisfy the students' appetites, I'll do all I can.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: First up, we have… the Deluxe Shrimp Alfredo Pasta Bowl!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For the sake of the academy's hungry students, Symboli Rudolf pushes her stomach to the limit.
